user.title: MOVA NutriPal
user.description: Connect to MOVA EU cloud. Automatic feeding is simulation only.

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed or feeder not found

data.video_codec: Live video codec (h264 compatible / hevc native)

add_calibration_measurement.name: Record calibration measurement
add_calibration_measurement.description: Select only the valid calibration samples sensor. Records a verified weighing without dispensing food.

measurement_date.name: Measurement date
measurement_date.description: MOVA local date (Europe/Paris), within the last 30 days.

portions.name: Dispensed portions
portions.description: Number actually dispensed during the weighing.

daily_counter.name: Daily counter after meal
daily_counter.description: Total portions dispensed that day, immediately after this meal.

weight_before.name: Weight before dispensing
weight_before.description: Kibble weight before the meal, in grams, excluding the bowl.

weight_after.name: Weight after dispensing
weight_after.description: Kibble weight immediately after dispensing, before eating.

confirmed.name: Verified weighing
confirmed.description: Confirm no food was eaten, added or removed between weighings.

record_physical_calibration.name: Record a physical weighing series
record_physical_calibration.description: Records a series without changing the reference or dispensing. Target only the valid calibration samples sensor.

trials.name: Weighings
trials.description: List of 3 to 30 objects {portions, grams}: net food weight in grams.

confirmed.name: Verified weighings
confirmed.description: Confirm independent weighings without consumption or added food.

mark_feeding_day.name: Mark a non-representative day
mark_feeding_day.description: Target only the feeding history sensor. Preserves raw counters and excludes the balance from representative data.

save_pet_profile.name: Save pet profile
save_pet_profile.description: Create or update a local profile. Target the Pet health tracking sensor.

pet_id.name: Pet ID
pet_id.description: Stable ID: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

target_kg.name: Target weight
target_kg.description: Individual target set with the veterinarian (kg). Optional.

baseline_date.name: Baseline date
baseline_date.description: Date of baseline measurement. Optional; otherwise first measurement.

color.name: Color
color.description: Color #RRGGBB; empty string restores the automatic color.

photo_url.name: Local photo
photo_url.description: Path /local/pets/name.jpg; empty string removes the photo.

record_pet_weights.name: Record pet weights
record_pet_weights.description: Import dated weights or add a measurement. Target the Pet health tracking sensor.

pet_id.name: Pet ID
pet_id.description: Stable ID of an existing profile.

measurements.name: Measurements
measurements.description: List with date, source (home/veterinarian/other) and weight_kg or gross_kg + cage_kg.

replace_existing.name: Replace existing measurement
replace_existing.description: Explicitly allow correction of a measurement on the same date.

record_food_period.name: Record food period
record_food_period.description: Local history of shared food mixture. Does not change feeding settings.

period.name: Food period
period.description: Start date, name, components and percentages by weight. Optional ration, portion weight and energy.

replace_existing.name: Allow replacement
replace_existing.description: Explicitly allow correction of the period on that date.

record_pet_care.name: Record pet care
record_pet_care.description: Local care log. Follow-up dates are entered manually, not medical recommendations.

record.name: Record
record.description: Pet, date, category, title, optional notes and follow-up date.

record_id.name: Existing record ID
record_id.description: For correction of an existing record.

renew_pet_care.name: Record new care and close follow-up
renew_pet_care.description: Close one open follow-up and record new care in one local save.

previous_record_id.name: Previous care record ID
previous_record_id.description: ID of the care record with the open follow-up.

expected_due_date.name: Expected previous due date
expected_due_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the follow-up to close.

record.name: New care record
record.description: Same pet and category; date, title, optional notes and next due date.
